# fjordrun_vpc_member (Resource)

Puts an environment in a private network. An environment can be in one network at a time, and plans limit environments per network (6 on Hobby, 30 on Pro). Its services become reachable from the other members at their project-qualified hostname (`fjordrun_service.private_hostnames`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "team_id" {
  type = string
}

resource "fjordrun_project" "shop" {
  team_id = var.team_id
  name    = "shop"
}

resource "fjordrun_project" "billing" {
  team_id = var.team_id
  name    = "billing"
}

resource "fjordrun_vpc" "backend" {
  team_id = var.team_id
  name    = "backend"
}

resource "fjordrun_vpc_member" "shop" {
  team_id        = var.team_id
  vpc_id         = fjordrun_vpc.backend.id
  environment_id = fjordrun_project.shop.default_environment_id
}

resource "fjordrun_vpc_member" "billing" {
  team_id        = var.team_id
  vpc_id         = fjordrun_vpc.backend.id
  environment_id = fjordrun_project.billing.default_environment_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment_id` (String) The environment to add.
- `team_id` (String) Team ID.
- `vpc_id` (String) Private network ID.

### Read-Only

- `added_at` (String) When it joined the network.
- `environment_name` (String) The environment's name.
- `environment_slug` (String) The environment's slug.
- `id` (String) `team_id/vpc_id/environment_id`.
- `project_id` (String) The environment's project.
- `project_name` (String) The project's name.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# team_id/vpc_id/environment_id
terraform import fjordrun_vpc_member.shop 11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111/bbbbbbbb-bbbb-bbbb-bbbb-bbbbbbbbbbbb/66666666-6666-6666-6666-666666666666
```
